scenario: AITA for my gf and I keeping our income low to apply for lower income housing. | Ok so this is weird. We also started trying to attack our debts together and would be basically living like poor people for the foreseeable future until we were out of debt. So this program would give us a head start. After the leasing period, if your income rises above 32000 a year you’d be asked to move into the normal studio (which is the same size and specs as the bond program one). We cooould afford to live in the normal apartments comfortably but it would take longer to pay off our debts. AITA?
